Five friends sit at the same dinner table, earning anywhere from ₹50,000 to ₹16 lakh a month. Does each bigger salary actually buy a better life?
In this video, I walk through their rent, spending, savings, family responsibilities and financial choices. We look at why earning four times more can mean saving ten times more, how a house purchase can change your freedom, and why a high salary can still come with debt and guilt.
